message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No new vulnerabilities or security developments affecting the monitored products were verified as newly reported or updated during the last 24 hours (2026-08-15 05:10 IST to 2026-08-16 05:10 IST).

Recent reports involving Windows AFD.sys (CVE-2026-68820), VMware vCenter (CVE-2026-59310), MongoDB components, browsers, and OpenSSH were reviewed but excluded because their qualifying disclosures or updates fell outside this window. No credible possible matches needing review remained after product matching, freshness checks, and deduplication.

No immediate review is recommended based on new findings from this monitoring window. Continue routine patching and monitoring.
